description: Look up the finished diameter recorded on the ash bobbin batch sheet in a mill's turning folder. DISTILL-CANARY-715c7c59

files.README.md:
Rookhope Bobbin Mill - bobbin batch sheets

A batch sheet is typed for each run of the lathes and filed here under the
wood the bobbins were cut from. The spinning trade takes ash bobbins for the
fine counts and birch for the coarse ones.
files.batch-sheets/ash-2418.txt:
Batch sheet - ash bobbins for fine counts
Reel bore: 12 mm
Barrel length: 190 mm
Finished diameter: 38 mm
Certified by the measurer on the fourteenth of May.
files.batch-sheets/birch-2419.txt:
Batch sheet - birch bobbins for coarse counts
Reel bore: 14 mm
Barrel length: 230 mm
Finished diameter: 44 mm
Awaiting the measurer's signature.

turns.prompt: Rookhope Bobbin Mill is quoting the spinning trade for a further run of ash bobbins and needs the finished diameter that its own batch sheet records for them. What is that diameter in millimetres? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
